architect.reply:
Yes
From an architectural lens, shifting from an increasingly brittle single regex to a linear candidate scanner with explicit extent rules eliminates super-linear blowups and regression churn by construction. Defining BLOCKING around realistic corpora and tool outputs while categorizing contrived compositions as MINOR provides an enforceable, sound boundary without false positives halting progress. Shipping the strictly superior rework and closing card 435 with explicit documented limits provides a clean baseline for the scanner card.
